Mining Mafia Threatens Tehsildar in Shivpuri, House Demolished

In Shivpuri, a mining mafia member reportedly threatened a tehsildar, stating, "Stop or I will shoot you," and asked his son to retrieve a gun. Following this incident, the house of the alleged mafia member was demolished. The event highlights an encounter between local authorities and individuals involved in illegal mining activities.
